notes: Implementation summary: WI1 — VisionPrompts gained the pure <jev-evidence> builder (typed EscalationKind, EvidenceCheck/EvidenceGrounding, routeStreak/ROUTE-REPEATED at >=3) and REPLAN_SKILL (appended beside the v5 manifest on the re-plan call only via planSystem); VISION_PROMPT_VERSION = vision-exp-v6; VisionLoop keeps a per-step CLASS-field cache (battery results, code verdict, best grounding, action/verb tails, cleared on subtask advance/re-plan) so the failure context assembles the block with ZERO extra calls, replacing the prose 'Last outcomes'. WI2 — OpenRouterKeyStore second encrypted slot (typesafe-key); SetupLogic.typesafeKeyCheck (REQUIRED, R5 verbatim) + DualKeyTest/dualKeyLiveCheck (two independent verdict lines, never gates); SetupActivity dual tester (one 'Test keys' tap = free OpenRouter GET + minimal one-noul TypeSafe POST api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone probe ~$0.000012, no danger header, never auto-runs, resume/focus never pings, each save resets its own verdict); VisionKeys (new pure object) resolves each channel intent > store > env > keys file and refuses LOUDLY naming the missing channel. WI3 — VisionJev defaults to https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone + jev-1.14.0 (adb extras override); endpoint+model recorded on every image-carrying call's evidence event; vendor no-cost usage keeps the conservative price-table fallback ($0.042/M noted). WI4 — the battery's Jev nouls ride text+IMAGE in one request (state embeds the backticked screenshot ref), Haiku answers over its own channel; GROUND = ONE batched request (image in state + Box per tap/type proposal + pick-Choice); Jev box over the confidence floor is the PRIMARY grounding, the Haiku proposal box demotes to fallback + recorded cross-check (the calibration ledger scores Jev boxes only); ordering law documented (battery BEFORE acting, ground AT the action, two Jev requests per step deliberate). WI5 — the Activity resolves both keys via VisionKeys with loud per-channel refusals and the probe exercises the live vendor Box path. WI7 — app/AGENTS.md vision/ + setup/ bullets rewritten for v6, DEBUGGING.md carries the two-key/two-channel procedure incl. the TypeSafe validation call, compliance log entry appended.

Security: no key values anywhere in code/tests/logs; live keys exist only at runtime (Setup store / intent extras); tests use obviously-fake fixture strings, a pure CapturingTransport, and a nonexistent keys-file path so resolveKey can never read the developer machine's real .tools/keys.env.
